changes: Updates ruTorrent to 5.3.12, with rTorrent and libtorrent 0.16.10.
Fixes torrents added through the watch folder stopping immediately after import. Imports can take up to five minutes. Previously stopped torrents may need to be started again after updating.
Fixes ruTorrent's DHT port setting with rTorrent 0.16.22 and restores automatic TCP buffer sizing. Existing custom configuration is preserved.
Updates rTorrent and libtorrent to 0.16.23. ruTorrent remains at 5.3.14.
Fixes the incorrect PHP argument-handling warning shown by ruTorrent on PHP 8.5. ruTorrent remains at 5.3.14, with rTorrent and libtorrent 0.16.23.

Updates ruTorrent to 5.3.15 with the upstream Finished-time fix. Newly created and already-complete torrents now receive a Finished time, while existing times are preserved. Adds the PHP XML support required by the updated XML-RPC proxy. rTorrent and libtorrent remain at 0.16.23. Hard-refresh ruTorrent after updating.
